Strategy: Scaled widest awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a quarter of the item and the full item lose a penalty of half the item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that wide awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by avoiding more awkward leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if r - item > item / 4 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled widest awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/4, item] by item/2, exact fit highest.
